model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е кръгова диаграма, която показва разпределението на различни категории герои в няколко категории. Диаграмата съдържа 16 сегмента, които представят различни видове герои. Сегментът в най-голям размер, оцветен в синьо, е обозначен като "Movie Characters". Следващият по размер и оцветен в синьо сегмент е обозначен като "Comic Characters". Следва сегмент, оцветен в светло синьо, „Teleplay Characters“. Следващият сегмент, оцветен в зелено, е "Virtual Characters" и включва подкатегориите "Custom Characters" и "Real Characters". Наследният сегмент, оцветен в светло зелено, е "Novel Characters", следван от сегменти като "Game Characters", "Influencers", "Actors", "Musicians", "Writers", "Artists", “Scientists” и “Scientist”.Вътре в някои сегменти са показани приблизителни проценти, например, "Custom Characters" представлява 16%, а "Real Characters" представлява 11%. Всички сегменти са последователно подредени по ъглов обход около центъра на диаграмата.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart represents the distribution of character types across various categories. The chart contains eleven slices, each labeled with a specific character type. The largest slice, colored light blue, is labeled “Comic Characters” and appears to occupy approximately 35% of the total area. A second large slice, colored a darker blue, is labeled “Movie Characters” and occupies roughly 25%. The third largest slice, colored light teal, is labeled “Teleplay Characters” and represents approximately 15%. Smaller slices include “Virtual Characters” (approximately 10%), “Custom Characters” (approximately 8%), “Novel Characters” (approximately 7%), “Game Characters” (approximately 6%), “Real Characters” (approximately 4%), “Scientists” (approximately 3%), “Artists” (approximately 2%), “Athletes” (approximately 1%), “Writers” (approximately 0.5%), “Musicians” (approximately 0.5%), “Influencers” (approximately 0.5%), and “Actors” (approximately 0.5%). The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise direction, starting with the largest slice and proceeding to the smallest. There is no visible legend, percentage labels, or visually emphasized slices within the chart.
model_annotations.German: Das Kreisdiagramm stellt die Verteilung verschiedener Charaktertypen in einem Medien-Dataset dar. Es enthält insgesamt 16 Segmente, die die Verfügbarkeit dieser Charaktertypen in den Bereichen Novel Characters, Game Characters, Virtual Characters, Real Characters, Custom Characters, Influencers, Actors, Athletes, Musicians, Writers, Teleplay Characters, Comic Characters, Movie Characters und Scientists darstellen. Das Segment "Real Characters" ist am größten und nimmt etwa 26 % der gesamten Darstellung ein, während das Segment "Custom Characters" etwa 16 % einnimmt. Das Segment "Game Characters" ist mit etwa 12 % im nächsten Rang und das Segment "Novel Characters" mit etwa 11 % dicht dahingegen. Die Segmente "Teleplay Characters", "Comic Characters" und "Movie Characters" haben jeweils etwa 8 % der verbleibenden Darstellung, während die Segmente "Actors", "Athletes", "Musicians", "Writers", "Influencers", "Virtual Characters", "Scientists" und "Scientists/Artists" jeweils etwa 6 % darstellen. Es ist eine Legende enthalten, die die Farbcodierungen der Segmente angibt: "Real Characters" ist grün, "Custom Characters" ist pink, "Game Characters" ist blau und "Novel Characters" ist orange.
